name: Scene Subtree Mover
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Refuses an index with an unquoted whole number above 2^53 in its frontmatter.
Adds free moves between parent groups with a complete subtree preview and source backup.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The plugin now refuses an index with an unquoted whole number above 2^53, because the save would change it.
Move a chapter or scene under another parent with a preview of the whole subtree and a backup. It is free.
tip: Select Manuscript root in Destination parent to promote a nested scene.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Scene Subtree Mover is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your writing.
